title: ui: the console reads and toggles a webhook by its bare name, so a name two packages hold answers 409 once #31699 PR 2 lands (ADR-0150 D3/D5)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Parent: #31527 (ADR-0150). Found by: the #31699 PR 2 dev (PR #32577, report 6816408638, `out_of_scope_findings`), at step 0. Not re-measured by the seat.

## Premise

PR #32577 lets two namespaces each ship a webhook of one name. With two holders, the bare `/meta/webhook/NAME` read and the bare activation door answer 409 naming both. The qualified forms are `?package=PKG` and the namespace address `webhook/:ns/:name`. The console addresses a webhook by its bare name, so with two holders its webhook view and its enable/disable toggle fail.

- Re-check, after PR #32577 is on `main`: install two packages that each ship webhook `w1`, open the webhook in the console, and toggle it. Today both requests carry no package.
- Likely surface (seat's estimate, not measured): `ui/packages/app-shell` metadata admin (`MetadataService.ts`) and the webhook activation call.

## Fix shape

Send the item's own package (`?package=` or the namespace address) on every webhook read and toggle, as #32367 does for actions. A one-holder name keeps working bare.

Same family as #32367 (console reads an action by bare name). That card is in flight, so this one carries the webhook location only.

Blocked-by: #32577
